To determine the number of frogs in a swamp, a
biologist catches a random sample of 400 frogs, tags
them, and releases them back into the swamp. Four
weeks later, the biologist catches a random sample of
140 frogs from this swamp, and 70 of them have tags.
Based on these samples, which of the following is the
best estimate of the number of frogs in the swamp?
